title: tier_policy.concurrency ignores classification-promoted starts when sizing a wave
body: widthForWave (internal/reconcile/window.go) and recordTierPolicy (profiles.go) derive a wave's tiers with TierPolicy.Derive, which uses a nil classification, while dispatch uses DeriveClassified with the recorded one. With host width 3, concurrency.balanced = 1, and three role-less ticks whose recorded mass clears the threshold, width stays 3 and three dear-tier dispatches run concurrently, and the planning line says the wave is not narrowed. Read the recorded classification (read-only, never ask) when computing first-attempt tiers for width.
